description: Fetches one vertodigital.com page as clean markdown, without navigation or footer: a service page, case study, blog post, ebook, pricing or legal page. Find slugs with vertodigital_search_site. slug "contact" returns the contact page plus who to contact (name, email, LinkedIn, reply time). Pages are fetched live and returned whole, most under 20 KB. An unknown slug returns an isError result with a hint, so guessing a slug is safe.

slug.description: Path such as "about" or "case-studies/ironscales"; a .md path or full URL also works. Empty returns the homepage.

name: vertodigital_get_page
